[[Raven]]s are one of the [[charmable animal]]s available in [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]. They are only found in [[Sacnoth Valley]] or during [[the Flight North]]; however, they cannot be charmed during the latter because the player is playing as [[Gwen (disguise)|Gwen]].

**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Charr Homelands]]
***{{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}} (see notes)

==Missions==
*[[Bonus Mission Pack]]
**[[Ascalon]]
***{{NPC location|The Flight North}}

==Notes==
* There are two Ravens in Sacnoth Valley (see maps):
** One spawns along the southern edge, including the location shown in the 1st map.
** If you don't want to fight through mobs to get to the first raven, the other is on the inaccessible plateau of a hill close to the portal from Dalada Uplands (2nd map). If you are patient (and find a good spot), the bird will wander within range of [[Charm Animal]]; once cast, you will still be able to charm the raven even if it moves farther away.

* Hearty, Playful, Elder, Aggressive, and Unevolved Ravens deal [[piercing damage]], while Dire Ravens deal [[slashing damage]].
* [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
